lines.en: [BY-9158's video broadcast is temporarily suspended.]

It was probably Biyoo's own decision. It might have been because of Bihyung's death, or there might have been a problem during our transfer to the Ark. Either way, it worked in our favor while we were on the run.
It would have been even better without the person standing in front of us.
“Anna Croft.”
I looked at the Prophet's blond hair fluttering in the wind.
I sensed more presences near the dense forest. Probably Zarathustra, the unit under her direct command.
—Why doesn't that stone or pebble thing work on her?
I didn't answer. I couldn't explain everything that had happened on Reincarnation Island right now.
Instead of waiting for my answer, Han Sooyoung gripped my wrist tightly. With her other hand, she pointed at Anna Croft, glaring at her. Fierce [Black Flames] flickered at her fingertip.
“Get out of the way or fucking die.”
Their gazes clashed in midair.

An eerie blue gleam filled Han Sooyoung's eyes as she activated [Predictive Plagiarism], while red energy shimmered in Anna Croft's [Great Demon's Eyes]. Faint sparks flew as the gazes of the two women who could read the future collided.
After holding that balance for a moment, Anna Croft spoke.
“Kim Dokja, you want to get off this floor, don't you?”
Han Sooyoung's face hardened as she growled.
“Hey, are you ignoring me?”
“I can help you.”
“After you came charging at us to kill us just now?”
As Han Sooyoung spoke, I sensed constellations nearby. Some were tearing up the terrain indiscriminately as they searched for us.
We couldn't buy much time.
“I had no choice. If I had taken your side there, we would have been swept away.”
“And things are different now?”
“Are you going to keep wasting time like this? You're the ones in a hurry, not me.”
“Do we have any grounds to trust you?”
“Were you ever the type to trust someone just because they gave you grounds to do so?”
Under other circumstances, I would have gladly accepted her help.
But Anna Croft had a direct contract with an entire nebula.
“You're the incarnation of the nebula <Asgard>.”
[The Giant Stories of the nebula <Asgard> awaken from their long sleep!]
And of all places, this floor was the cabin where <Asgard>'s constellations stayed.
Anna Croft readily acknowledged it with a nod.
“That's right. I'm their incarnation. Doesn't that make this even stranger? I'm looking right at you, so why aren't they coming?”
I, too, was watching the constellations prowling nearby.
They seemed unable to hear our conversation.
Apparently, she had blocked their view somehow.
“What are you thinking?”
I met Anna Croft's deep, inscrutable eyes.
[The exclusive skill 'Reading Comprehension' activates!]
「Anna Croft is an incarnation who, more than anyone else, values a greater cause grounded in reality.」
In a sense, Anna Croft was the one who pursued the greatest good in this world.
If Yoo Joonghyuk's cause was made of rage and hatred, Anna Croft's was made of justice.
The survival of the overwhelming majority.
Her goal had been to preserve her birthplace, Las Vegas, then the United States, and ultimately the entire Earth, within the hell of these scenarios.
「But in this worldline, the United States had been destroyed.」
Her hometown had vanished the day the Great Apocalypse occurred. Now all she had left were the few members of Zarathustra who followed her.
Even so, Anna Croft's expression wasn't dark. Rather, it was full of a certain zeal. The expression of someone who had finally drawn closer to the world she wanted.
Feeling the gentle vibrations reverberating through the entire ship, I spoke.
“You're planning to take this Ark.”
Beside me, Han Sooyoung gave a low murmur, seemingly reaching the same answer at almost the same moment.
Then Anna Croft smiled.
“As expected, it's a pleasure talking to someone who catches on so quickly.”
“It won't be easy to drive the constellations out and take the Ark.”
“But it's humanity's last chance.”
Anna Croft's plan was clear.
The Final Ark was a Giant Story weapon that carried the seeds of Stories into another worldline.
If she could defeat the constellations and gain control of it, she might be able to transport humanity to a new worldline.
There, everything would begin again.
“I can't leave a single constellation alive. Even if that constellation is you.”
Hearing that, I recalled an old sentence from Ways of Survival.
「Anna Croft's ■■ is 'Complete Night.'」
A world of darkness where no starlight shone.
Anna Croft wanted humanity to be free in that darkness once more.
In the world she dreamed of, all my companions could probably survive.
Feeling a little lonely, I spoke.
“Then this will be a temporary alliance. We'll only travel together as far as the Ark's 'core.'”
“Until then, I'll lend you the power of my [Future Sight].”
Beside me, Han Sooyoung sent me a message.
—I've been checking with Lie Detection the whole time. No lies. She doesn't seem to have activated Poker Face, either.
I nodded.
“All right. I accept the alliance.”
I read the terrain around us, tracing the Story Bihyung had left behind.
「Outside the forest zone. The exit by the branch that reaches the sky.」
As we followed Anna Croft, I realized that we weren't standing on a plain, but on one level of a tree.
—They've done a pretty good job realizing this worldview.
Han Sooyoung murmured with apparent admiration.
Looking at the meticulously realized worldview of <Asgard>, I could feel just how long the Final Ark had been in preparation.
This wouldn't be the whole of Yggdrasil, the cosmic tree. At most, a sample.
Even so, the tree was vast enough. With this Story as their foundation, <Asgard>'s constellations could probably continue to enjoy their privileged positions in the next worldline.
Anna Croft watched those constellations quietly, then turned her head and concentrated on scouting ahead. Watching her, Han Sooyoung asked,
—But will she be okay? There'll be a hefty price for betraying her nebula.
Before I could answer, Anna Croft spoke.
“My circumstances are none of your business.”
“…What? You can even eavesdrop on this?”
“You hadn't spoken for a while, so I merely assumed you were having a private conversation.”
“Got some backer you trust, then?”
For the first time, Anna Croft's expression stiffened at Han Sooyoung's words.
“What are you talking about?”
“I'm just wondering whether it's remotely possible for a mere incarnation to block the view of an entire 'nebula'.”
Han Sooyoung was right. No incarnation could do such a thing.
I stared steadily at the space behind Anna Croft.
[The concentration of the exclusive skill 'Reading Comprehension' increases further!]
I did have a suspicion.
An aura of Chaos softly dissolving behind her.
Beyond it, I thought I caught a glimpse of red eyes resembling Anna Croft's.
There were only two species in this world capable of interfering with the channels the constellations watched.
Rrrrrumble!
Just then, a sudden bolt of lightning fell from the sky. The ground split, and the surrounding weather shifted ominously. It was the sound of a storm coming.
[The constellation 'One-Eyed Father' slowly blinks his single eye.]
Tzzzzzzzt!
Anna Croft's face was turning pale, too.
Even the creator god Ra, whom we had fought in scenario 98, hadn't exerted that much pressure.
A fathomless Status surpassing even that of Thor, whom we had just seen.
The strongest being in this worldview had just awakened.
“…Odin.”
We began to run.
No matter how strong <Kim Dokja's Company> had become, facing the Myth-grade constellation Odin on <Asgard>'s own soil would be idiotic.
[The constellation 'One-Eyed Father' looks upon his world.]
A terrifying gaze swept across the world. Before long, I felt as though something was looking at us.
“This way! Hurry!”

In the direction Anna Croft pointed, a trunk leading to Yggdrasil's upper levels appeared. We ran along it. Almost at the same time, the trunks beneath our feet began to lose their strength and collapse.
“Faster!”
I ran with all my strength and moved the wind.
[The exclusive skill 'Way of the Wind Lv.???' activates!]

Strengthened further by the Giant Stories we had gathered, Way of the Wind accelerated my companions. I wanted to unfold my wings with [Demon King Transformation] if possible, but the wing I had injured just before the transfer was recovering slowly.
Thudududududu!
Something was chasing us.
[The constellation 'God of Harp and Horn' hears their father's command.]
[The constellation 'Goddess of Love and Cats' obeys her father's command.]
[The constellation 'One Who Lost His Arm to the Wolf of Apocalypse' howls!]
[The constellation 'Guardian of the Great Horn Bridge' has noticed someone's presence!]
“We're almost there!”

As she spoke, Anna Croft turned and stretched both hands behind her. The scenery changed in an instant, obscuring the view of the entire area. It was [Illusion Barrier], her specialty. The constellations cried out in shock as their surroundings went dark.
Tzzzzzzzt!
Anna Croft's eyes became bloodshot, then blood began flowing from her mouth and ears. The price of directly defying her own nebula. Even so, she refused to yield and shouted,
“Iris! Selena! Take our companions with you!”
The two women running ahead of us led Zarathustra toward the tip of the branch.
“Run! It's just ahead!”
Anna Croft was coughing up blood, and one knee was already buckling. There was no way she could keep running on her own.
“Han Sooyoung.”
Before I had finished speaking, Han Sooyoung scooped Anna up and ran. Soon, we reached the end of the branch. A mysterious bridge shimmering with rainbow light lay before us.
「The rainbow bridge to another floor, [Bifrost].」
A fantastic bridge straight out of mythology lay before my eyes. Selena, Iris and their group were already more than halfway across.
I activated [Electrification], intending to propel myself across in a single burst. But then.
Kaaaaa-boom!
A flash of light streaked through the air, and the middle of [Bifrost] snapped apart.
A huge spear cutting through the sky was being recalled.
I recognized it at once.
Gungnir, the weapon of Odin, King of the Gods (神王).
He had decided to eliminate us by personally severing the bridge to another world.
I bit my lip as I looked at the constellations pursuing us.
If we fought Odin here, we would certainly lose.
Rrrrrumble!
In the end, crossing the bridge was our only option.
But the gap was far too wide, and a storm Odin had created raged between the broken halves. Even at full power, [Way of the Wind] or [Electrification] offered no guarantee of crossing it.
Han Sooyoung shouted in frustration.
“Hurry! Don't you have a way?!”
Jostled in Han Sooyoung's arms, Anna Croft forced out words between mouthfuls of blood.
“My Future Sight… isn't perfect, either… But this time… I saw it clearly. The four of us… crossing this bridge…”
…Four? I wanted to ask, but Anna Croft had lost far too much blood and had already fallen silent.
At that moment, a scene came to mind.
「Kim Dokja thought, 'Will that work?'」
But there was no other way. Looking up, I saw indirect messages pouring in from constellations bewildered by the sudden change in the channel.
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' wants to see the channel's video!]
[The constellation 'King Heungmu the Great' complains about the channel's sudden blackout!]
[The constellation 'Bald General of Justice' searches for the missing Kim Dokja!]
“Biyoo! Turn the video on!”
“What? Are you insane?”
If we opened the channel now, every constellation in the Ark would learn my location.
But this was only possible with the channel open.
Tzzzzzzzt!
[Many constellations are startled by the scene on their screens!]
[Some constellations realize your predicament and are horrified!]
[A small number of constellations feel a sense of déjà vu about this situation.]
I knew exactly what that sense of déjà vu was.
「Once, they had crossed a broken bridge together.」
The Deus Ex Machina that had activated over the broken Dongho Bridge.
[The overwhelming majority of constellations remember what happened then!]
[The Giant Stories of the nebula 'Kim Dokja's Company' stir!]
With the constellations' gazes upon us, probability surged.
['Stage Transformation' activates!]
Tzzzzzzzz…!
['Deus Ex Machina' occurs!]
The very bridge those constellations had reenacted back then was being recreated before my eyes.
[Deus Ex Machina ― Even Bridge]

Description: A bridge of light created by a constellation's blessing. Only an ‘even number’ of people may cross it. If an odd number of people attempts to cross, the bridge will disappear immediately.
Even Bridge. It had been a very long time since I heard that name.
“Han Sooyoung! Take Anna and run!”
“What?”
“Hurry!”
I activated [Way of the Wind] on Han Sooyoung, forcing her across the bridge.
—Hey! Ah, fuck it…!
Watching her receding back, I turned around.
The constellations had escaped Anna Croft's [Illusion Barrier] and were appearing one by one.
I released my Status toward them and thought,
「Only an even number of people can cross Even Bridge.」
Far away, Han Sooyoung's voice alternated with Odin's furious roars.
And I drew [Unbreakable Faith].
I had no intention of dying here.
「Anna Croft said 'four.'」
As I discharged the lightning of [Electrification] at the charging constellations, an explosion rang out at the rear of their ranks.
Someone was smashing through them like a tank, running toward me.
A familiar Story. Someone had just been summoned to this floor.
His face appeared beyond the thickening mist of Stories.
—Keep running, Kim Dokja.
Having swept aside every enemy and smashed the constellations' skulls, the bastard was coming with a murderous look in his eyes.
I smiled bitterly. Anyone else would have been fine, but I hadn't wanted to cross with him.
—Don't throw me this time, you bastard.
Yoo Joonghyuk running toward the bridge, and <Asgard>'s constellations chasing him.
The Bald General of Justice shouted.
[Keep it up, descendants!]
Then the One-Eyed Maitreya muttered.
[Your head's all sweaty.]
[Worry about your own head.]
[Aren't you going to help?]
[How can I go when I have no incarnation?]
[Just manifest there yourself.]
[Have you gone mad from being trapped here so long? There aren't even enough coins left to manifest a symbolic body.]
Grumbling, the Bald General of Justice wiped his head and looked back.
Behind him stood a large training ground in monotonous shades of gray.
The scenario area on floor 92, 'Infinite Sanctuary.'
Many Historical-grade constellations, including the Bald General of Justice, had already been trapped here for decades. They could only escape after clearing all ten missions.
The One-Eyed Maitreya grumbled.
[All this suffering because of that damned Cheok.]
Goryeo's First Sword had been the first to discover the <Infinite Sanctuary> area.
「A true martial artist ought to go there. The trials are very easy, too. You could call it a place like hidden grain syrup.」
The Maritime War God, who had cleared the scenario after Cheok Jungyeong, had said,
「It's worth a try. If you can just pass it, you can achieve something remarkable.」
Admiring Cheok Jungyeong and Yi Sunsin's martial prowess, the Historical-grade constellations had all headed for Infinite Sanctuary after hearing that.
And now, decades later, here they were.
[For a moment back then, we forgot we weren't Cheok Jungyeong or Yi Sunsin.]
Talent was the problem everywhere.
The Bald General of Justice let out deep sighs.
The clash of weapons rang repeatedly from the center of the training ground.
[Are those two still fighting?]
Where the One-Eyed Maitreya directed his single eye, two old men were brawling.
A tiger-like man with hulking muscles, and a fox-like man with a lean, firm build.
As their two swords collided in midair, powerful sparks flew.
[Kim Yushin! Today, we settle this!]
[Gyebaek, you're still no match for me.]
「Stage Transformation」 occurred around them, unfolding the battlefield of Hwangsanbeol. The very battlefield Kim Dokja had once created with [Ganpyeongui].
Kim Yushin's Yonghwa Hyangdo attacked Gyebaek, who raced through the battlefield like a ghost, releasing a formidable Status of his own.
It was an impressive battle, but the other Historical-grade constellations merely watched with bored eyes.
Supreme Maegum shook their head, while the Founder of Hannamgun clicked their tongue.
The One-Eyed Maitreya sneered.
[They can put on all the airs they want. They know this isn't Hwangsanbeol anymore.]
Surely, there had once been a time when they meant it. Deep grievances, and resentment that not even death could resolve.
They had staked everything on their battle at Hwangsanbeol.
There had certainly been such a time.
[The Story 'Hwangsanbeol at Sunset' continues its story intermittently.]

Once someone became a constellation, their own 'Story' was what wore out fastest. As constellations' stories ran dry, their power weakened. They became bored and weary, falling into deep depression or being eaten away by ennui.
To escape that mire, constellations inevitably began searching for other Stories.
They set out to find another tragedy, seeking even a moment's release from the shackles of this terrible eternity.
Claaang!
As their weapons collided faster and faster, Seo Ae Il Pil spoke.
[Still, they're putting a little more strength into it than before.]
[They seem to have gotten fired up again ever since the Demon King of Salvation summoned them.]
At Supreme Maegum's words, the constellations turned toward the scenario channel together.
Kim Dokja and Yoo Joonghyuk crossing the bridge.
Han Sooyoung was shouting from the other side, where she had already arrived.
—Kim Dokja! Faster!
The noisy clash of weapons stopped. Even Kim Yushin and Gyebaek, who had been reenacting Hwangsanbeol, were holding their breath. One by one, they ambled over to the panel.
Some made knowing remarks about the bridge Kim Dokja was crossing.
[Wait, isn't that Even Bridge? That brings back memories.]
[What nonsense. You weren't even subscribed back then.]
[Ahem…]
Odin was pursuing Kim Dokja and Yoo Joonghyuk. The divine spear Gungnir, said never to miss, was aimed at Kim Dokja's back. The storm was growing fiercer, slowing their advance.
The One-Eyed Maitreya shouted.
[Come on! Doesn't Odin have some dignity as a Myth-grade constellation—]
[Dokja-gun is a Myth-grade constellation, too.]
[Not all Myth-grades are the same! Our Kim Dokja is still a fragile little newcomer to the grade!]
As though they had never been fighting, Kim Yushin and Gyebaek sat side by side before the screen and shouted, too.
[Our descendant has been neglecting his training.]
[He might call me with Ganpyeongui. I should get ready…]
[You, Gyebaek? In a situation like that, of course he'd summon me.]
As Hwangsanbeol seemed about to be reenacted once more, the One-Eyed Maitreya warned them.
[Both of you, shut up and watch the screen.]
[By the way, he isn't going to throw Kim Dokja again, is he?]
Sparks flew from Yoo Joonghyuk's right arm as he ran across the bridge.
While all the constellations watched anxiously, he suddenly grabbed Kim Dokja by the collar with that arm.
[I knew it! I knew he'd—]
Yoo Joonghyuk hurled Kim Dokja forward with all his strength and trampled on his back, using it as a foothold. Yoo Joonghyuk, advancing against the storm as though he were surfing.
The next instant, Gungnir, hurled by Odin, set off an explosion in an immense burst of light.
Kaaaaa-booom!
When the light cleared, only the wreckage of the broken [Bifrost] remained.
[…What happened? Did they make it?]
Soon the screen changed, showing Kim Dokja's group in the next compartment.
[…Oh, they made it!]

The constellations of the Korean Peninsula looked at one another in delight, as though it were their own achievement. Even Gyebaek and Kim Yushin exchanged awkward looks and lightly bumped fists. But their joy didn't last.
—After them.
At Odin's furious command, <Asgard>'s constellations began to move.
「<Kim Dokja's Company> would not be able to keep running for long.」
Everyone knew it. Even Kim Dokja couldn't escape the great nebulae for long on such an unfavorable stage.
Moreover, now that the channel was public, the other nebulae in the Ark would soon begin targeting <Kim Dokja's Company>, too.
Into the heavy silence, someone murmured in resignation.
[It'll be difficult this time…]
[To tell the truth, he should have died long ago.]
Several constellations nodded.

Kim Dokja's survival until now had been one miracle after another. When he fell from Dongho Bridge, when he broke the [Absolute Throne], when he became the Demon King of Salvation, when he visited the 1863rd round. Kim Dokja should have died so many times.
When he appeared as an 'Outer God King,' every constellation had thought that this time, he would finally die.
「An incarnation who, just a few years ago, had been in scenarios far below theirs.」

Now they were watching Kim Dokja's back as he advanced through a scenario ahead of their own. Some watched with envy, others with self-mockery. They all had something they wanted to say, but none dared voice it.
Gyebaek was the one who spoke.
[I once overheard Shindansu's prophecy. It said this worldline might be the last.]
No one knew where <Kim Dokja's Company> would end.
No one knew where they would finally arrive, or what ■■ they would see. As many expected, they might meet their end without even reaching the end of this world.
Leaning on his great saber, Gyebaek slowly stood.
His gaze was fixed on the portal at the center of the training ground. The place where Infinite Sanctuary's final trial awaited.
Kim Yushin asked,
[Surely you don't intend to try again? You could die this time.]
[If I die, then this will be my ■■.]
At Gyebaek's words, Kim Yushin smiled.
[Our ■■ is Hwangsanbeol.]
Cracking his neck, Kim Yushin stood, too.
The third to rise was the Bald General of Justice.
[I'll give it another try, too.]
His eyes shone with resolve.
Then several more constellations stood. Supreme Maegum, the Founder of Hannamgun, Seo Ae Il Pil… And.
[You haven't forgotten how we nearly got wiped out when we went as a party last time, have you?]
At the One-Eyed Maitreya's words, everyone's expression darkened.
They had never managed to pass this scenario's final hurdle.
[But if we don't get through there, we can't go help them.]
Infinite Sanctuary's final chapter had never been something so few people could clear.
Cheok Jungyeong, a weapon unto himself, and Yi Sunsin, who commanded a warship, were the monsters. If only they had even a few more constellations—
Just then, a corner of the sanctuary shone brightly.
[Someone has entered the tenth floor of 'Infinite Sanctuary'!]
The One-Eyed Maitreya cried out in delight.
[Oh, a newcomer?]
Two people appeared in the light.
A moment later, the One-Eyed Maitreya realized who they were and gaped. One very large person, and one very small person.
The small one spoke first.
[Cheok Jungyeong was right. You're still here? Pathetic fools.]
Radiating fierce spirit, Kyrgios spoke.
[My disciple is about to die because you've been dragging your feet.]
As the light shattered all at once, Yoo Joonghyuk and I were sucked through the worldview's exit.
When I came to my senses, Yoo Joonghyuk was stepping on me.
“I told you not to throw me!”
He lightly dusted off his combat boots, as though stepping on my back had dirtied them.
Han Sooyoung, who had been waiting for us, approached. Judging by her expression, she was about to snap at us again. Fortunately or unfortunately, Anna Croft spoke first.
“I didn't know you could use Stage Transformation that way. Honestly, I'm a little impressed, Demon King of Salvation.”
Then Han Sooyoung turned toward Anna.
“Didn't you see everything with [Future Sight]?”
“I saw us cross the bridge. I didn't know it would be that sort of bridge.”
“What a complete fraud.”
Ignoring their argument, I examined our surroundings. Passages resembling the vascular bundles of a stem branched out in every direction.
Apparently, these were the Final Ark's corridors.
The members of Zarathustra who had entered ahead of us were nowhere to be seen.
After closing her eyes briefly to sense something, Anna Croft said,
“They seem to have scattered into different passages. Fortunately, no one has died.”
“Our companions seem to be safe, too.”
I nodded at Yoo Joonghyuk's words.
[The influence of other myths weakens in this area.]
[The context of the nebula <Kim Dokja's Company> is reactivated!]
Once outside <Asgard>'s worldview, I could gradually sense my companions' Stories. They were scattered all over.
[The Story 'Demon King of Salvation' announces its presence!]
I released my Story forcefully, guiding my companions to gather in one place. They should have no trouble finding me.
Kaaa-boom!
Explosions rang out one after another from <Asgard>'s entrance, which we had closed behind us.
Someone was trying to open the door and come out. It was obvious who.
“Let's keep moving.”
We ran through the tangled passages to escape <Asgard>'s constellations.
[The constellation 'One Who Lost His Arm to the Wolf of Apocalypse' catches the scent of blood.]
[The notes of the constellation 'God of Harp and Horn' hover by your ears.]
[The constellation 'Progenitor of Reincarnators' tracks your soul!]
[The constellation 'Master of Abydos' declares you will have no second chance!]
Some constellations cheered us on through the channel, while others used its view to pursue us.
Stars that, the moment our location was revealed, showed their murderous intent toward us across the barriers of their own worldviews.
Even so, we had avoided capture because of the four people gathered here.
“Don't turn right. I have a bad feeling about it.”
Trusting Anna Croft's intuition, we changed direction. She was an enemy, but at times like this, she was our most reliable ally.
Another junction appeared.
[The Story 'Predictive Plagiarism' begins its story!]
“Right means a 92% chance of death. Left means 44%. Keep going straight!”
Reading countless patterns of clichés in her head, Han Sooyoung shouted.
“What are our chances of surviving if we go straight?”
“I don't know, either!”
Glaring at me, Han Sooyoung ran ahead.
“They're coming from above.”

The protagonist's intuition, no less. Yoo Joonghyuk unleashed [Splitting the Sky Energy] continuously. Caught by his preemptive attack, the constellations tumbled to the corridor floor with screams. Now and then, I heard [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] slicing through something.
“Keep running.”
Suddenly, I felt I understood why the four of us had gathered.
「These four were the people who could clear this scenario most safely.」
One was a prophet, one a writer, and another a regressor.
And the last one was…
“Stop.”
My companions stopped at once. All three looked at me. Glancing at them, I slowly approached the cabin ahead.
Anna Croft caught my shoulder.
“…Surely you aren't thinking of going into that room?”
Yoo Joonghyuk said nothing. I turned toward my companions.
“Going through here is the only way.”
“Can't you see what's written on that cabin?”
I could see it perfectly well. And I could feel the tremendous Status of the constellations beyond it just as clearly.
<Olympus>.
「To reach the place I want, I must pass through <Olympus>'s worldview.」
According to Bihyung's Story, there was no other route.
Of course, Zeus, whom we had humiliated outside the Ark, would never let us through.
“Odin behind us, Zeus in front.”
Yoo Joonghyuk stepped forward and spoke.
“If we break through here, will you have a way to fight them?”
“Yes. Definitely.”
I could feel Odin's Status pursuing us just behind.
Han Sooyoung shouted.
“Damn it, then open it already! Those bastards are coming!”
We kicked open <Olympus>'s door and rushed inside. Something sucked us in forcefully, and when we regained our senses, we were gliding through <Olympus>'s sky.
In the distance stood <Olympus>'s magnificent sky castle.
[The constellations of the nebula <Olympus> have identified the intruders!]
The atmosphere was hardening. Thunderclouds gathered in an instant, covering the sky.
[The constellation 'Lightning Throne' exerts his influence throughout <Olympus>!]
The king of <Olympus> was waiting for us.
And the Twelve Gods guarding their king.
[The constellation 'Almighty Sun' moves his chariot!]
[The constellation 'Atrocious God of War' picks up his sword!]
[The constellation 'Pure Hunter of the Moonlight' takes aim with a drawn bow!]
Below, I saw the monsters of myth waiting in the sea.
[The constellation 'Monster of the Labyrinth' roars at you!]
[The constellation 'Fairy Who Sings of Death' sings of your death!]
This entire worldview was our enemy.
Rrrrrumble!
“Move!”
My [Way of the Wind] and Yoo Joonghyuk's [Air Steps] activated together.
Anna Croft's [Gale Highway] and Han Sooyoung's [Black Cloud Seven Stars] followed. We raced through the sky at the highest speed we could muster.
The thunderclouds above took on an increasingly ominous hue.
[Demon King of Salvation!]
The Twelve Gods followed close behind.

Ares's huge sword tore through the air toward me. I swung [Unbreakable Faith] and barely blocked it. With a crunch, I felt every joint in my body buckle. As though I were pinned beneath a heavy tank. This was the true power of one of the Twelve Gods backed by their own worldview.
I released the Status of my entire body and spoke in my True Voice.
[Don't underestimate me, Ares.]
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' roars!]
I might lose to someone else, but I would not lose to Ares.
Because I had a Story of victory over him.
[The Story 'One Who Defeated the God of War' begins its story!]
But we were already in trouble.

Artemis, the Pure Hunter of the Moonlight, charged at Han Sooyoung, who was wreathed in [Black Flames]. Yoo Joonghyuk, darting through the air, was already locked in a fierce battle with Athena, the Spokesman of Justice and Wisdom.
Below us all, Anna Croft was being harried by <Olympus>'s lesser constellations.
[I supported you, Kim Dokja.]
A voice from behind me.
The fastest constellation in this sky. Wing patterns on the tips of the shoes.
[But you should never have come here.]
It was Hermes, the Master of the Skywalk.
Looking at me with regret, he continued.
[Father is very angry.]
Then the thunderclouds, glowing incandescent white, exploded. Everything moved as though in slow motion. My view of the sky vanished as if melting away.
Lightning covering everything in this world. No being alive within this worldview could escape Zeus's wrath.
Han Sooyoung looked at me and shouted something. I told her,
'It's okay.'
I slowly drew a breath and concentrated. I could see Ares smiling triumphantly, as though the battle were already over. Ignoring him, I raised my sword toward the sky like a lightning rod.
Kaaaa-boom!

The lightning in the sky converged on me. A Status strong enough to burn every Story channel in my body at once. But I endured it. More precisely, the darkness flickering at my fingertips was absorbing Zeus's lightning.
An incomprehensible scream burst from my mouth.
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' growls!]
My vision turned red, and Stories kept forcing their way out of my mouth.
Tzzzzzzzz…!
Zeus released an even stronger Status.
I couldn't endure any longer. My strength failed, and my body began to fall.
「That's enough.」
[It's over, Demon King of Salvation. Even you, within our 'worldview'—!]

My body, falling helplessly after the lightning strike, stopped in midair. Strength returned to my grip on [Unbreakable Faith], which I had nearly dropped. I could see Ares's frozen expression. Fear spread through the eyes of the god of war, who bowed before no terror.
「Someone was holding Kim Dokja's sword with him.」
A very large, sturdy hand. A True Voice rang out, as though carving a noble night.
[Why do you think this worldview belongs to you?]
The gentle, deep darkness that had caught my falling body.
[Such boundless arrogance, Ares.]
A night that devoured lightning spread through the sky.
[The constellation 'Father of the Rich Night' has manifested in the 'Final Ark'!]
[The constellation 'Queen of the Darkest Spring' has manifested in the 'Final Ark'!]
<Olympus>'s myth didn't belong to Zeus alone.
Their shining day could become a 'myth' because there was a night that called them day.
[The 'Underworld' manifests upon the surface!]
The world that had slept in the deepest reaches underground was awakening.
[Hades…!]
After setting me down on the ground, the king of the Underworld looked up at the sky and spoke calmly.
[The time has come to settle this, old brother.]
As the scythe Hades had raised toward the sky rang out, the darkness below poured upward like a waterfall.
The Underworld's army. At the judges' command to advance, Cerberus, who had guarded the depths of <Tartarus>, howled.
[You lowly things from underground—!]
The heroes of this worldview clashed weapons. The heroes of the Argo entered the battlefield.
The armies of Zeus and the Twelve Gods were formidable. Judge Aeacus clashed with Hephaestus, while Cerberus and the Minotaur tore at one another with their teeth.
The soldiers of the forest, led by Artemis, rushed in. The hooves of Chiron, the Wise Astrologer, trampled the Underworld's forces.
[No matter how deep your night may be—!]
Chiron's head flew through the air.
Monsters crawling out from underground tore his head off with huge fingers and crunched it between their teeth.
[Ze—us—!]
Voices stained with deep sorrow and resentment.
I knew them.
「And so, <Olympus>'s final <Gigantomachia> was beginning.」
The giants, the Gigantes. All the giants who had crouched below ground through bitter years were revealing themselves upon <Olympus>'s night.
There were even monsters several times larger than those Gigantes. Beings I had once met in the <Underworld>'s prison.
[All the giants of purgatory look up at <Olympus>'s sky.]
The three Hecatoncheires brothers.
And Briareus, the Hundred-Handed Giant who had fought beside us in <Gigantomachia>.
[So you've finally come this far, child.]
One of Briareus's hands lightly brushed my head.
[This battlefield is for you.]
The giants challenging the throne of heaven rose upon the night. Their roars shook <Olympus>'s firmament. A Status powerful enough to threaten Zeus's throne.
At the center of the battlefield, Zeus was locked in combat with Hades. As the two Myth-grade constellations clashed, pitch-black day and night mingled, crumpling the world's space and time.
Persephone, commanding the Underworld's forces, spoke to me.
[Go. Never look back. See the ending you desire.]

I nodded and struggled to my feet. When I swallowed a [Life and Death Pill] Lee Seolhwa had given me, my burned nerves gradually began to recover. I staggered out through the battlefield, where flesh was torn apart and blood sprayed.
Han Sooyoung, Yoo Joonghyuk and Anna Croft were waiting for me after making their way through the carnage.

Han Sooyoung ran over and supported me. Looking back, I saw the corpses of heroes who had died with their eyes wide open. Stars fallen from the sky. Stories that would never be told again looked up at me as though in resentment.
「This was the path I had chosen.」
I had known from the beginning that this would happen.
Of course the Underworld would move if I came here.
I had used all those Stories for the ■■ I wanted.
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' wails!]
Far away, I could see <Olympus>'s exit. The way we had to go.
But a constellation stood in our path.
I asked him,
“Dionysus. Are you going to stop us?”
Dionysus, the 'God of Wine and Ecstasy,' stood looking at me at the head of his followers. His cheeks were flushed, as though he had already drunk several bottles.
Dionysus gazed at me as though in a drunken haze, then spoke, gripping his bottle.
[Everyone, move aside.]
At their master's words, the fanatics of Bacchus cleared a path. We walked along it. Somewhere, I could hear a siren's song and Orpheus's music. I also heard what sounded like someone I knew dying.
「Kim Dokja did not look back.」
My surroundings swayed, too, as though drunk.
We walked, and walked again. At last, we reached <Olympus>'s exit.
Dionysus stood behind us. If I turned, I would see his expression steeped in sorrow. He was a constellation who had loved our story dearly.
[Kim Dokja. Our <Olympus> won't be in the ending you're heading toward, will it?]
I couldn't answer.
「“Because I like your story, of course.”」
Someone who had followed my Story for so very long.
A being who had saved me so many times.
「“A few other constellations and I believe you are someone who can reach ■■.”」
As I tried to turn back, Dionysus spoke.
[It has been a pleasure, great star.]
Behind me came the sound of a world closing.
It was hard to take another step.
After I had stood wordlessly for a long time, someone spoke.
“It isn't over yet.”
We walked through the darkness of the Ark, where the lights had gone out.
Our destination was now before us.
After passing through <Olympus>, we said nothing for a while. We just ran, or walked, then ran again. Only hollow screams sounded where the stars had been.
Would those screams remain as Stories, too? Would someone hear them again? How many more Stories would have to be repeated before this world ended?
“Kim Dokja.”
“I know.”
Hearing Han Sooyoung's voice as she supported me, I barely managed to pull myself together.
At last, the cabin door I had been searching for began to come into view in the distance. A door that looked small and shabby even from afar, unlike the entrances to the other cabins.
The corridor behind us was growing noisy. The sound of constellations from different factions clashing. Without hesitation, I opened the door.
[You have entered the 'Prop Storage Room.']
“What? This shabby—”
Han Sooyoung's muttering died away the moment the room's interior unfolded before her.
A room coated in white paint, its size impossible to judge at a glance. If this was a 'Prop Storage Room,' it would be the largest prop storage room in the world.
「The cabin where 'everything from the scenarios' was gathered.」
Bihyung's Story spoke.
「Every prop used in the scenarios so far was on display there. From consumable items to major scenario rewards and the Star Relics of nebulae that had lost their power.」
There was even the 'Mucus of the Hammer Seahorse' and the 'Stone Hog's Thorn' I had used to hunt the ichthyosaur.
I really thought I would die back then… Seeing them like this brought back so many feelings.
“Not bad. These are still usable.”

Yoo Joonghyuk had already strode in among the props and was changing his equipment. He coated the surface of the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] with Story metal spray, replaced his coat with a new one, then tossed aside his old combat boots and picked up a Star Relic.
Judging by his gleaming eyes, he seemed pleased.
“'Just usable'? These are things we've never even seen before! Quick, grab them and let's get out of here.”

Han Sooyoung had already plunged into a pile of items and was busy choosing things to wear. Even Anna Croft, who had always received lavish support from her nebula, was bending over to search for items.
Like ordinary incarnations who had found a hidden piece in a scenario, we searched for items, changed our equipment, and smiled at one another.
「They all knew. Without doing this, they wouldn't be able to endure this moment.」
Another explosion rang out beyond the room.
This time, it was very close.
“…Which room is next?”
Perhaps because she was tired, Han Sooyoung had paused [Predictive Plagiarism]'s story for the moment.
When our eyes met, the corners of Han Sooyoung's eyes quivered slightly.
「“You think telling stories is always fun just because I'm a writer?”」
Now I could understand what that smile meant.
Even if the world ended, even if the scenario headed for tragedy, she was still a writer. That would make it all the more painful. Even the suffering left undescribed would exist inside her head.
「That was why only he, the 'reader,' could make this choice.」
“No. We're going to fight here.”
「Only he, filled with greed and a stubborn insistence on seeing the ending he wanted no matter what, could make that choice.」
Han Sooyoung snapped.
“Aren't we supposed to destroy the inner core?”
“To reach the inner core, we have to pass through more of the great nebulae's worldviews.”
“We can avoid them! If we go out that door—”
As she spoke, Han Sooyoung walked toward a door standing alone in one corner.
“That door leads to <Emperor>.”
“Then that one—”
“And that door connects to <Vedas>.”
“Fuck…”
Recoiling from the handle in horror, Han Sooyoung pressed the cabin's lock.
Another explosion rang out. Amid heavy vibrations, someone was pounding on the cabin door. With the sound of something bursting, the walls shook violently.
“…They're right outside now.”
Anna Croft spoke. Already frowning deeply, Han Sooyoung pressed a hand to her forehead again.
[The Story 'Predictive Plagiarism' resumes its story!]
In the end, Han Sooyoung activated her Story again. Developments she didn't want to predict would be forming in her head.
Anna Croft, with her [Future Sight], and Yoo Joonghyuk, who had read patterns through countless rounds, began preparing as well.
“We have to fight here. This is the only room where we have a chance of winning.”
The worldviews of the great nebulae were made real in every cabin of the 'Final Ark'.
「But there was one place in the Ark where no such worldview had been created.」
This 'Prop Storage Room'.
A place stocked with items to be used in scenarios.
[This cabin is unaffected by any worldview.]
That was why I had chosen this room as our battlefield.
“They're here.”
The moment Yoo Joonghyuk drew the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] by its hilt, the doors on all four sides of the storage room burst open together. Constellations began crossing through them.
[The constellation 'Master of December 25th' has manifested in the Ark!]
[The constellation 'One Responsible for the Cycle of the Universe' joins the battle with their attendants!]
<Vedas>.
[The constellation 'Master of Abydos' manifests in anger!]
[The constellation 'Overseer of Earthquakes and Volcanoes' awakens from a long sleep!]
[The constellation 'Ruler of Inhalation and Exhalation' awakens their Story!]
<Papyrus>.
[The constellation 'One-Eyed Father' adjusts his grip on his spear.]
[The constellation 'One Who Lost His Arm to the Wolf of Apocalypse' spots you!]
<Asgard>.
[The constellation 'Great Mother God Who Created Man out of Earth' has manifested in the Ark!]
[The constellation 'Great Heavenly Venerable' has manifested in the Ark!]
[The constellation 'Huangtian Shangdi' has ascended their throne!]
[The constellation 'Master of Three-Pointed Double-Edged Spear' has taken out all their treasures!]
…And <Emperor>.
The moment every door opened, the Stories throughout the room collided and expanded. The 'Giant Stories' of different worldviews were raising their voices.
Han Sooyoung laughed.
“Everyone who hates us has come running.”
[Over there!]
As someone shouted, we all leaped backward. With a roar, black ashes scattered over the floor where we had just stood.
[The 'Giant Stories' have discovered a new cabin!]
[Some Stories begin transplanting their worldviews into the new cabin!]
We didn't have much time.
Kaaaa-boom!
With the explosion, we each drew our weapons. I, too, had already gathered all sorts of scenario props.
Standing back to back, facing north, south, east and west, we released our Status toward the approaching constellations. Han Sooyoung hurled herself forward, unleashing [Black Flames].
“Die, all of you!”
The black sphere Han Sooyoung threw flew through the air and landed among the constellations. I wondered what it was, and the next moment, tremendous flames boiled out of it.
[Kraaaaaah!]

I recognized it at once. It was [Nightmare Blaze], the reward item from scenario 95 of the 241st round. Containing flames drawn from <Eden>'s hell, it was a vicious Story Weapon that set the area within its range ablaze and kept it burning for roughly ten years.
[Mere flames from a fallen nebula—]
With a whoosh, Nuwa's earth opened a path through the center of the inferno. <Emperor>'s constellations charged along it toward us. Some had fought against us in Journey to the West.
Han Sooyoung ground her teeth furiously.
“They're here already, so why aren't you, Black Flame Dragon?!”
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' shouts for you to wait just a little longer!]

The number of constellations coming through the doors climbed past a few hundred. Three hundred, four hundred, five hundred… Every constellation scattered within those worldviews was entering this enormous room.
As their numbers increased, 「Stage Transformation」 occurred around them. The colorless ground became a barren desert, and a huge pyramid rose.
Osiris, the 'Master of Abydos,' spoke.
[So you're the one who woke me.]
Then the clouds gathered above, revealing the scenery of the celestial realm.
Nuwa, the 'Great Mother God Who Created Man out of Earth,' spoke.
[It isn't too late, child. I can prepare a place for you.]
[Who gave you the right?]
I thought I heard an elephant's cry from somewhere, and then Mithra, the 'Master of December 25th,' spoke from atop a huge tortoise's head.
[Death is the only punishment for one who rejected my 'Feast of Resurrection.']
Perched at the end of a branch of the cosmic tree, Odin watched me with an eye that saw through everything in the world.
[Foolish star. Do you truly believe you can face us all?]
A burst of laughter.
Every star whose Giant Story was secure in this safe 'Ark' was laughing at us.
[With a Story that hasn't even become a 'myth,' you dare—]
With a sharp hiss, something pierced the mouth of the 'Thunder Eating Bird,' who had been drawling insolently at us.
Yoo Joonghyuk had already moved behind the constellation and cut off their head.
“You talk too much.”
[Kill them!]
The fight began. Overwhelmingly outnumbered, we fought by making full use of the props around us. Story Weapons we could use lay everywhere.
The armory for scenarios in the 80s, in particular, was truly Yoo Joonghyuk's battlefield.
[The Story 'Life and Death Companions' begins its story!]
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ begins its story!]
The talent Yoo Joonghyuk had already displayed in the 'Demon King Selection' was shining through.
Yoo Joonghyuk, the all-rounder. Having mastered every weapon over the course of 1,863 rounds, he was slaughtering constellations with a great bow.
[Kill that one first!]
Historical-grade constellations died under his rapid fire, creating a barricade from the remains of stars. We ran and fought between them.
[Dodge right!]

With Anna's warning, a Myth-grade constellation's assault swept past our feet. A single hit would inevitably inflict a critical injury. With our stock of Lee Seolhwa's [Life and Death Pill] nearly exhausted, we couldn't afford any more serious injuries.
Asgard's lower-ranking constellations charged at Anna Croft.
[You dare betray our nebula?]
Crack!
The speaking constellation's head burst apart.
Something like a long tongue had shot out from behind Anna Croft, bursting the constellation's head.
[A constellation who enjoys changing gender sneers.]
The backer who had helped Anna betray her nebula was helping us.
“Kim Dokja! We can't hold out much longer! Yoo Joonghyuk's at his limit, too!”
The Myth-grade constellations' gazes were converging on Yoo Joonghyuk. The armory burned, and drenched in blood, he swung a huge hammer against the constellations.
「Kim Dokja began searching the storage room for something.」
“Found it.”
I pulled out a test tube from the very end of the [Star Relic] section. It bore the following label.
[Shindansu Seed].
Without hesitation, I released the seed onto the floor. It sprouted as soon as it fell. In an instant, the shoot grew into a tree as tall as me. Then it stopped growing.
[The Giant Story 'Shindansu' puts down its roots!]
[The Giant Story 'Shindansu' recognizes your existence.]
[The Giant Story 'Shindansu' requires a Story for Opening Heaven (開天)!]
The storage room was burning.
Yoo Joonghyuk was still holding out well. Constellations who met his venomous gaze cried out in alarm.
[This is the 'Prop Storage Room'! Use the items to fight them!]
The first item they discovered was one we knew very well.
[Absolute Throne].
The key item of the fourth scenario. An item whose mere acquisition could grant the protection of the 'Outer Gods'.
The Historical-grade constellations who spotted it rushed toward it with greedy eyes.
I stopped Han Sooyoung as she tried to run toward the throne.
“Leave them.”
The Historical-grade constellations swarming toward it.
[The throne is mine!]
The very moment someone climbed onto the [Absolute Throne], I gripped a leaf of [Shindansu].
No matter how much I thought it over, this was the only suitable Story to feed it.
Some constellations sensed something amiss and shouted toward the [Absolute Throne].
[Wait, stop!]
As the Status flowing from the [Absolute Throne] flooded toward us, something stirred deep in my chest.
[The Story 'King of a Kingless World' begins its story!]
[The Giant Story 'Shindansu' senses the beginning of a new myth!]
「That story began with the breaking of a throne.」
Kwakakakaka!
Having devoured the Story, [Shindansu] gained an explosive surge of probability and began to grow.
[A new worldview puts down roots in this area!]
「Shindansu」.
The Giant Story of the great nebula <Hongik>.
I spoke to the constellations.
“As you said, we have no 'myth.' But we've always fought those 'myths.'”
The Story began to tell its story.
「No myth can escape that story.」
The next instant, [Shindansu] reached the storage room's ceiling with a thunderous roar. The Ark's roof was collapsing.
[Opening Heaven (開天) begins!]
Amid a fearsome vortex, the sky began to open.
[The old stars of an ancient nebula awaken from their long slumber!]
Amid dazzling radiance, the shadow of branches in full bloom appeared through the torn sky.
At the tips of that shadow, stars began to form like fruit.
[That throne. It's been a long time.]
Seven stars hanging from the tips of the branches. The Constellations of the Big Dipper, who had helped me destroy the [Absolute Throne], were there.
Countless constellations began falling from the sky like meteors.
[The constellation 'Bald General of Justice' manifests in the Ark!]
[The constellation 'King Heungmu the Great' manifests in the Ark!]
[The constellation 'Supreme Maegum' manifests in the Ark!]
[The constellation 'Heavenly Wind God' manifests in the Ark!]
The only stars in this Ark who would take our side.

Among the falling constellations, a lightning-like sword strike descended, and the [Absolute Throne] exploded. Trampling the false king atop the shattered throne, a constellation looked at me and spoke.
[Well done, descendant.]
[The constellation 'Goryeo’s First Sword' manifests in the Ark!]
